changelog:
- Removed documentation/sample files: creating.md and skill-card.md.
- All financial modeling usage, rules, and guidance now reside within SKILL.md.
- Clarified that this skill inherits all officecli-xlsx v2 rules and focuses on advanced financial modeling protocols.
- Expanded model triggers to cover LBO, SaaS unit economics, ARR, IRR, and scenario/sensitivity workflows.
- Documentation more strongly distinguishes when to use this skill vs. base xlsx skills (simple budgets, KPI sheets, CSV conversion).
- Emphasized three-zone architecture, audit discipline, and cross-sheet/circular formula best practices for financial models.
summary: Use this skill when the user wants to build a financial model — 3-statement model, DCF valuation, LBO, SaaS unit economics, sensitivity / scenario analysis, debt schedule, or fundraising projections — in Excel. Trigger on: 'financial model', '3-statement model', 'P&L + BS + CF', 'DCF', 'WACC', 'NPV'
